newsitem.title: GREECE: BROKERS PICK THEODORIDIS, DEPOLAS FOR BOURSE BOARD.
newsitem.headline: BROKERS PICK THEODORIDIS, DEPOLAS FOR BOURSE BOARD.

text.p: Athens stock exchange member brokers picked Artemis Theodoridis of Alpha Brokerage and Leon Depolas of Depolas Securities to represent their association (SMEHA) on the Athens bourse's nine-member board.
They also voted Alexander Moraitakis of Nuntius Securities and Athanasios Halkiadis of Athinaiki Brokerage as substitute board members.
SMEHA's vote on Tuesday took a second round to produce the result. Seven brokers had expressed interest and were candidates for the two allotted slots on the exchange's board of directors.
They were Victor Asser of Telesis Securities, Alekos Papadopoulos of Intersec and Gelli Petroulaki of Ergo Securities.

Earlier the union of institutional investors picked their representative on the bourse's board -- George Vlahakis of European Reliance fund management. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
